title: David Zaslav's payout from the Paramount and Warner Bros. merger is put at $606 million
dek: Variety reported the figure on Thursday. A film account's post of it has nearly a million views, and the replies are not congratulations.
what: Variety reported that David Zaslav, the chief executive of Warner Bros. Discovery, receives a $606 million payout from its merger with Paramount. Earlier filings had valued the package at up to $887 million depending on when the deal closed, and a shareholder advisory firm had urged investors to vote against it while backing the merger itself.
why: A nine-figure number attached to one name. The most liked replies to the post are angry, and several go further than this page will quote.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: ISS backs Warner Bros.-Paramount deal but rejects Zaslav's golden parachute
